findings.title: GOV-017's brief and session-close.md's mirror omit a checkout of the branch, which both gating reviewer types require, while PROMPT-036's templates add 'the worktree path' and call it the GOV-017 brief.
findings.evidence: GOV-017-multi-session-coordination-protocol.md:168-176 and :190 (three-bullet brief, 'Both get the same brief'); .claude/commands/session-close.md:111-120 (same list); .claude/agents/demo-adversary.md (run commands against the worktree path in the dispatch prompt); .claude/agents/demo-validator-code.md ('plus the worktree's absolute path'); PROMPT-036-build-coordinator.md:327-331, :333-339, :336.
findings.consequence: A Session Manager following GOV-017 literally gives the gating reviewer no file tree to Grep/Glob and no worktree to run Bash in, contradicting its charter; this review itself only ran because the coordinator added a checkout the text does not authorise.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a fourth brief bullet in GOV-017 and session-close.md: a checkout of the branch at the reviewed commit, for the gating reviewer (which has Bash); state that the shadow judge (no shell) does not need or get it.
